findings: l.1927: 'the family (E_theta)_{theta >= 0} is analytic' includes theta = 2pi, where E_{2pi} is regular (its developing map descends to a homeomorphism onto Minkowski space, GX.mass_two_pi_sing_eq_empty), so S_{2pi} subset of sing(E_{2pi}) = emptyset violates def:family_singular_manifolds_endowed's non-emptiness and the family is not analytic as printed (GX.not_isAnalyticModelFamily_two_pi); brunswic2021cauchy Prop 1.3 assumes alpha != 2pi. l.1927: 'It follows from Proposition 1.3' needs, beyond Prop 1.3's local form, a globalisation (an a.e. isomorphism of connected opens meeting S agreeing with an automorphism on an open set agrees everywhere: rem:morphisms_analytical_two_equal, DEC-42) and that sing(E_theta) is the whole axis also for theta in 2piZ \ {2pi} (trivial holonomy; GX.mass_sing uses the m-to-1 developing map instead). Both are proved here.

Cross types (E_0 vs E_alpha): proved by the radial limits of the lift — an isometry g with g . D_alpha = D_0 . L would send two points of the timelike axis to cluster values of the BTZ developing map at the axis, i.e. onto the lightlike line Delta (GX.btzDev_cluster), impossible for an isometry (GX.mass_to_btz_false). Massive vs massive: g keeps the time axis, hence is a rotation-translation (GX.isom_eq_of_timeAxis), one turn theta is k turns theta', and injectivity forces k = 1.

hypotheses.paper: BTZ-manifold (l.2262; 'a singular E-manifold whose singular locus is locally modelled on E_0', l.2300)
hypotheses.note: GX.btz_manifold_virt_tame assumes GX.IsBTZSingModelled M (every singular point is the centre of an E_0-chart, the l.2300 gloss = the hasType clause of IsXAManifold); the IsXAManifold form (DEC-67 (e)) is GX.btz_xaManifold_virt_tame via GX.IsXAManifold.isBTZSingModelled; the atlas clause is unused (AUDIT-1 m1)

hypotheses.paper: standing: M Hausdorff, locally path-connected, first countable, connected

hypotheses.note: through its proved descending form GX.isVirtuallyTame_of_hasMaximalLifts (Models, 0 sorry): all its hypotheses are checked — {E_0} analytic (GX.isAnalyticModelFamily_btzFam), E_0 locally Galoisian (GX.isLocallyGaloisian_btzE0), Aut(E_0~) T_BTZ-continuous (GX.btz_hasAutContinuousTamifying, WP-41b), and every singular point is the centre of a box chart whose preimage components in E_0~ are maximal coverings (GX.hasMaximalLifts_btzBox, GX.exists_xaChart_hasMaximalLifts)

findings: l.2266: 'Topologically, BTZ is homeomorphic to R^3 and sing(BTZ) is a line. Therefore BTZ is locally Galoisian' — local Galoisianity is about every open subset U (reg U slsc in U), not only BTZ itself; true (proved by radial contraction in cylindrical coordinates E_0 = C x R, GX.btzE0_isSLSCIn_reg_opens), but the inference from 'homeomorphic to R^3 with a line' needs the line to be straight in some global coordinates, which cylHomeomorph provides.

l.2266: the proof applies theo:local_virt_tame, whose general case is an open tagged sorry in Models (DEC-86); for E_0 every chart restricts to a box whose lifts r : V~ -> V^ are isomorphisms (a covering with simply connected regular part is maximal, GX.exists_homeomorph_maxBranched_of_simplyConnected), the case proved there, so the row closes without the open case.

findings: l.2302-2304: 'the singular locus being a 1-submanifold of non trivial holonomy, M~ is exactly branched over sing(M)' - proved (GX.btz_manifold_sing_subset_branchingLocus) by a holonomy-free argument: a box chart's descent Psi would identify two Gamma-related regular points of E_0~ while D_M o Psi = g . D_{E_0} there and D_{E_0} is injective (GX.btzDevM_injective).
l.2300: 'BTZ is locally Galoisian so M~ -> M is Galoisian' - proved: reg M slsc in M through the charts (GX.btz_manifold_isSLSCIn_reg), then prop:Galoisian_semilocal (GX.maxBranched_isGaloisian).

l.2309-2312: T_BTZ is a topology on E_0~ (defi:BTZtop is on J^+(Delta)), not on M~; 'continuous for T_BTZ' on M~ needs the topology transported chartwise. The transport is well defined because Aut(E_0~) is T_BTZ-continuous (overlaps of lifted charts differ by automorphisms); it is the glued topology of theo:local_virt_tame's proof (GX.btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying).
l.2310: the paper never defines a 'BTZ~-manifold' (it defines E_0-manifolds only, l.2300); the reading taken is the local one (a question).

'continuous for the tamifying topology T_BTZ' (l.2309): is the reading 'continuous for the tamifying topology of M~ that is chartwise T_BTZ' (the glued topology, GX.btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying) accepted?

kb_proposals: maxHeartbeats is per declaration: long proofs juggling MaxBranchedCover/connectedComponentIn exceed 200000 at the declaration's docstring position ('timeout at whnf' at col 0); a `set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in` before the docstring fixes it — first bisect with truncation to check it is not a genuine loop.

Local `haveI : ConnectedSpace ↥(V : Opens _)` / `LocPathConnectedSpace ↥V` introduced early in a proof about MaxBranchedCover make later elaboration much slower; introduce them just before the lemma that needs them.

A second structure on Orbits (GammaA α) (DInfty × ℝ): use a `def` type synonym (GX.MassModel) to keep it apart from BTZModel's; lemmas on Orbits apply by defeq; pass the structure explicitly with named instance binders ([s₁ : SingularGXStructure ...]) in generic cylinder lemmas.

A family indexed by Option with match-defined instances (GX.eFam): instance search does not unfold the match, so also declare T2Space/LocPathConnectedSpace/... instances on `eFam a` by match and instantiate generic lemmas at `eFam (some θ)`, not at `MassModel θ.1`.

GX.cyl_lift is the lifting step of B21 Prop 1.3 for any two cylinder models (any periods and developing maps); GX.isom_eq_of_timeAxis classifies Isom(M^3) elements keeping two points of the time axis on it (rotation + time translation, via linear_isometry_complex and det_conjAe).
GX.exists_homeomorph_maxBranched_of_simplyConnected: a branched covering with simply connected regular preimage is the maximal covering — the cheap route to HasMaximalLifts for small charts.

A binder `∃ T : TopologicalSpace α, ...` (or an `obtain`ed T) is a LOCAL INSTANCE for the rest of the statement/proof: every later `𝓝 x`, `IsOpen`, `connectedComponentIn` on α silently uses T. Bind it as `WrappedTop α` (Models) and write `T.top`, or keep it as `H.choose` in proofs.

With non-instance topologies, dot notation (`hc.tendsto`, `h.comp`, `hP.dense`) re-synthesizes the instance and fails with 'synthesized type class instance is not definitionally equal'; use the @-form with the topology passed explicitly (@Continuous.tendsto _ _ T _, @Continuous.comp _ _ _ T _ _ _ _, @IsPortly.dense _ T _).

GX.btz_exists_liftedChart / GX.btz_manifold_tilde_isLocallyBTZTilde: the lifted E_0-chart at a singular point of M~ (bijective, natural and (T_BTZ,T') homeomorphism, D o Psi = g . D_{E_0}) — the API Section 4 should use for local statements on M~.
